warnings.message: Consider using `apply()` instead; `commit` writes its data to persistent storage immediately, whereas `apply` will handle it in the background
warnings.reason: Synchronous commit is required for acknowledgement durability and failed-commit rollback; replacing it with apply would remove the completion result and alter this boundary. Send ledgers likewise keep their synchronous pre-submission commits.
